summary_1line: Bhima and Shalya knock each other down with maces; Vrishasena defends the Kaurava army until Pandavas respond, while Drona breaks through and slays Kumara.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima and Shalya crash together with iron maces and both fall simultaneously like shattered pillars on the battlefield.
Vrishasena stands alone in his chariot unleashing thousands of blazing arrows that streak outward like summer sunrays.
Drona with red steeds charges into the Pandava host and strikes down Kumara amid a storm of arrows.
